name: honeyhive-observability
description: Export Claude Code session telemetry to HoneyHive. Captures tool calls, prompts, turns, permission decisions, subagents and session artifacts for observability and evaluation.

HH_API_KEY.title: HoneyHive API key
HH_API_KEY.description: Your HoneyHive API key. The project is resolved from the key. Leave empty to use an HH_API_KEY already exported in your shell, or the key stored by 'honeyhive-daemon init'.

HH_API_URL.title: HoneyHive API URL
HH_API_URL.description: Base URL for the HoneyHive API. Only set this for self-hosted or non-default endpoints. Leave empty to use the daemon default.

HONEYHIVE_DAEMON_BIN.title: Daemon executable
HONEYHIVE_DAEMON_BIN.description: Absolute path to the 'honeyhive-daemon' executable. Only needed when the daemon is installed in a virtualenv that is not on the PATH Claude Code sees. Leave empty to resolve it from PATH.
